variants.note: Peak rpm disagreement: GM kits and CSM say 5000 rpm; Standard Catalog says 5200 rpm. SAE abstract 820116 gives 38 kW/5000 rpm (Isuzu). Rating unchanged every year.

unverified.block_material: Cast iron per Standard Catalog of American Cars ('Cast iron block and head'). The GM 1984 MVMA page leaves the diesel column blank for block material. Only one source.
unverified.head_material: Cast iron per Standard Catalog only. GM 1984 MVMA page shows '--' for the diesel's head material. Aluminum not found in any source. One source.
unverified.firing_order: GM 1984 MVMA page prints 1-3-4-2 only in the gasoline L17 column, with the diesel column empty. No source states it for the 4FB1.
unverified.induction_detail: Indirect injection / prechamber: GM kit ('Pre-chamber design: Ricardo Comet V') and Curbside Classic ('naturally-aspirated indirect-injection'). Only 2 sources.
unverified.engine_name: Isuzu code 4FB1 per Wikipedia (Chevette and List of Isuzu engines; counted once). Not C180/C223, which are other Isuzu engines. No second source names 4FB1 for the Chevette.
